page.layout: One column of text on the right printed page; page number at the top right beside the head. No marginal notes. A catchword at the foot right. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

page.notes: Printed "Prater" in italic at the line end; the Greek and Latin Gothic-style forms were read as printed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "Præalii" in the gradus list (the print may read Prœlii or Præliii) and the spelling "Prater" in the last line. The verse quotation "QVI CORONAT TE IN MISERATIONE ET MISERICORDIA." is set in capitals with italics. The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page and was excluded.
